authority.plane: One megaworld. Hub at origin. +x east toward Cyber (gate angle 0). +z north toward the Sundering (gate angle π/2). Angles copied from Canon.Gates.
authority.walk_model: travel_minutes_walk_est is atlas time: 5 km/h road, 3.5 km/h walker, 15 km/h coastal sea, 20 km/h river barge, 12 km/h open Exodus, 3 km/h waystone scramble. It is not the Present-metre jog. A Link gate is 2 minutes of plaque, not 400 km.
authority.honesty: countries.json claim radii of about 18–28 local metres overlap and are claims, not these discs. Unplaced encounter anchors stay null. Design-intent offsets are labeled.

seas.inner_veil: Water and shoal in the ring marches where a coast exists, especially Tunya–Sundering and the Iron Coast river lane. The Crown Roads are the dry spokes through the same annulus.
seas.exodus_ocean: Basin outside the Canon Ring on the southwest-to-south arc. Sere sits in it. The Crime–Sere line is the short strait. The Frontier–Sere line is the long ocean. Ark Exodus is the historical bridge in the lore, not a ninth spoke.

worlds.notes: HubMetroKm 40 and HubCourtKm 12 are MegaworldMap constants. Approaches to about 80 km are design-intent before Crown Roads enter the open ring. Flower Law is 42 local metres, not 42 km.
Off-ring. MegaworldMap places Sere at 1.35 × ring radius on Crime's angle plus 0.35 rad. No Link gate. Waystone is not a ninth door.

Catalogue forum. Design-intent. Envoy compound local pin (63.86, -9.91) is a Ruins-local metre pin, not this sector and not Pinewood.
The Unfinished. Catalogue, do not conquer.
Iron Coast wharf, toward the Exodus side of the disc.
Tenement and sodium streets. Display name Iron Coast. Gate bearing 5π/4.
Grid stacks and sky-bridges. Census counts. One number stays missing on the plinth.
Under-District maintenance. Glitch Chapel is a physical broken layer, not a hologram costume.
Council hitch and open road. The Last Dome spawn stays the unplaced sentence 'one mile past the frontier gate' and is not given metres here.
Drift gap. Morning Chevron and Canvas Dive use floor_drift_gap. No mesa is placed.
Kane Tower crown and roof pads. Aegis skyline. Mercy is the law.
Bronx Arterials and low-rent glass. Neural clinics are civic infrastructure.
Unclosed lattice. Stairs lean and still snap to 4 m.
Disc edge toward the Unclosed Foundry blend. The blend is not a new world.
Furnace Belt. One furnace eye is the emissive. Design-intent inside the 80 km disc.
Old Capital. Exhausted real infrastructure.
Spire City footing.
Breadlands. Stubble and repair, not a clean pastoral.
Flooded Lowland and the river delta side.
Contested Passes, toward the short Exodus strait and the Crime disc.
Offshore Haven. Water is polluted infrastructure, not a resort coast.
Highland. Wind and extraction heads.
Waystone on the Crime-facing coast. Not a Link gate. Not a ninth Refusal door.
The Last Dome. Spawn anchor in S13: open flat one mile past the frontier gate. Until placed, spawn nothing. This atlas does not invent that mile.
Uncounted Wharf, arch_ix_grid_coast. Sits on the Crime–Cyber march. Wet asphalt floor. No separate world id.
Held Crown Stair, arch_ix_sunder_dawn. On the Sundering–Dawn relationship as a stair, not a new continent. Granite flight reads at 100 m.
Unclosed Foundry, arch_ix_crucible_foundry. Crucible, Iron Coast brass, Frontier scrap. Clock missing its last numeral.
